Title: General availability: Migration service in Azure Database for PostgreSQL

Body.Content:
We are delighted to announce a new migration service within Azure Database for PostgreSQL designed to streamline the transfer of your PostgreSQL workloads to Azure. This fully managed service offers a straight-forward migration process, expertly managing the transfer of schemas and data regardless of size. Eliminate complex setup procedures and embrace a solution that scales with your needs, ensuring a smooth transition. 
 
By choosing to migrate, you benefit from enhanced performance, strengthened security, and simplified database management. Our service ensures minimal downtime, so your operations continue uninterrupted. Plus, with Azure's global infrastructure, your data is always close to your users, reducing latency and improving user experience. 
 
Start your migration journey today and transform your database management with Azure. Discover how our migration service can help you achieve a more secure, efficient, and scalable data environment. Learn more about the benefits and how to get started. 

Learn more.
